notes.title: Magicland Demo Anniversary Update
notes.notes: [p]After another year of working on this fabulous project, I have something very exciting to share today![/p][p][/p][p]Magic-lovers, I present to you... behold:[/p][p][/p][h2]It's the demo again, but better[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/31f0603cd6a1d55e03ae8468fd124647611cfbfc.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]50% MORE music![/p][/*][*][p]100% MORE gameplay!![/p][/*][*][p]200% MORE cutscenes!!![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]So, why did I do this? Isn't this slowing things down? [/h2][p]No, in fact I probably just saved myself an enormous amount of time in the future. When I refactored the game's dialogue system to use Yarn Spinner instead of... [i]string Lists[/i]... I left a lot of lose threads unwound. Sure, it kind of worked for basic dialogue, but cutscenes? Complex events? Multi-NPC conversations? No, it was all still pretty dysfunctional and broken. So I figured before I made 4 more entire areas using a half-functional dialogue engine, I should make sure everything is good-to-go in the areas I already made. And BOY am I glad I did.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/13d9e695b1b832a08df96060e853aa4c71c9eb13.png"][/img][/p][h2]So what is this other stuff you added then huh[/h2][p]First and foremost, the item system. In the old demo, you could just walk up to someone when you're holding an item, and they would automatically notice you holding it and be like "WOW, nice item you got there buddy, can I take it off your hands?" I realized this style of dialogue would get boring and dumb pretty fast. Why would I not say yes to that if I know giving items away is the only way to progress the story? The game would just become a matter of talking to every NPC until something happened. LAME.[/p][p]So here we have the item delivery system. It's much more reminiscent of puzzle solving games where you have more agency in using your resources. It also solves 2 problems mentioned previously. First, it cuts out the need to ask the player for consent to take the item. Second, since only NPCs who want items will have this delivery menu, it narrows down who the player needs to talk to to progress the story and will probably be less annoying. I don't necessarily want the difficulty puzzles to be the main draw of this game, I want it to be more about the journey you go on through the world as you complete them.[/p][p][/p][p]Now second I'll discuss all the fun stuff, most of which was added to the tutorial area. I felt like the original area didn't set a good tone for the game, it felt too dull and streamlined. But tutorial areas are usually dull and streamlined, so I wanted to make fun of that instead of being that. So it has this new song called "Tutorture", a song that is both funny-sounding and makes you want to leave the area as fast as possible. I also added some more humor in the form of a cutscene and some random NPCs to make the area seem less like deserted truck stop.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/b0ab272f21d57bfb5960c455e8d77b6585239c61.png"][/img][/p][p]Last thing I'll mention is the graphics. My eye for colors and pixel art has gotten so much better in the past year, let alone since 2022 when most of the Town graphics were made. A lot of things just looked too grey, muted, and unpolished. So once I started updating some of the more egregious set pieces, it started a chain reaction to where now most things have been updated to reflect my modern skillset. See if you can notice any big changes! (hint: start with the trees)[/p][p][/p][h2]So what's next?[/h2][p]I'm going to hit the ground running on the new areas! First up will be the Farm. I have a strong idea for the design of that section, so I think if I can grind a loose gameplay path in about a month that can be played through IN GAME, then I might be good in hitting my previously stated deadline of 2027. THEORETICALLY, getting the gameplay in now that I have an area fleshed out and an engine that doesn't suck could go pretty fast. We we will have to see about that one...[/p][p][/p][p]But in the meantime, stay magical, and thank you for reading and playing![/p]

notes.title: Magicland: 2025 Mid-Year Progress Update
notes.notes: [h1]2025 Progress Update![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello my beautiful followers. This year so far has been very exciting and encouraging for Magicland. Without further ado, I present to you: CONTENT (also peep those image carousels for more)[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Magic City: 70% complete (!!!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/4e3c88bdb6f608c0409ac65dab07223eeb223123.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/3b22396d5168fa2392959b0ba6b2bc30bf460729.png"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p]Farm Town: 60% complete[/p][/*][/list][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/a8249b132f969081489bab2958e62374c8593e40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/2bb86428dc1e3401d88dcc97a7864b1bee25a998.png"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p]Enchanted Forest: 40% complete[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/df7cf8202d956a04d27cf4f53201e560c6e421bf.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Desert: 1% complete (barely started)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/7da705ebcdbe0d5d0edf9ac5233c779e24e2b1b0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Swamp: No change from [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3137050/announcements/detail/533211329960347559?snr=2___"]last update[/url] (30% complete)[/p][/*][*][p]Other Areas: ???% complete[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/50686e2a06889f0b5458b0b342aaed873635b6a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/cd15e41034762fa15a8c6dd95c476e187569e708.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140768/0a6562a6b38b14acdf82a1c6633792c31aa3ab84.png"][/img][/carousel][/*][/list][p]Wow! Look at that progress. I really focused in on the areas that I was the most excited about and had ideas for, like Magic City. That area is definitely the most ambitious so now that it's the most "complete-feeling" one it's definitely a huge weight off my shoulders. Every major area got at least some attention... except the swamp. Sorry swamp! You'll definitely be on the docket in the later half of this year.[/p][p]The really good news is now I have a loose vision of what the goals in each area will revolve around. Here's a little teaser of that:[/p][list][*][p]Swamp: The town elder is trapped in the great tree since the bridge was destroyed. Save him! And maybe encourage the downtrodden townsfolk along the way[/p][/*][*][p]Farm Town: You're the new kid in town, and are looking for love! Well, at least according to the town priest. Pick your favorite single and shower them with gifts, just like in your favorite farming games. But what's going on with the animal residents?[/p][/*][*][p]Enchanted Forest: Become the next hero of legend! Find the hero sword (again?) and defeat the dragon, or whatever. Yeah, that sounds about right. This sacred and mysterious area has become quite the attraction for Magicland visitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Magic City: Welcome to the city of dreams, where everyone wants to make a name for themselves and show off their magic abilities. You become acquainted with an unlikely successor to a professorship at the highly regarded magic school, but he feels lacking in his abilities. Apparently there's some really powerful magic hidden at the top of the Wizdome that could help you both in your goals...[/p][/*][/list][p]The other thing I want to note is the desert area. Previously, I called this place the "Cyber Desert", but now I'm changing course. It's going to be something a lot more... interesting. And secretive ;) It will be one of those "woah, what the heck just happened?" moments that all of the great games have these days.[/p][p]With that out of the way, though, I will be answering some questions that I ask myself often while developing.[/p][h2]Is this still on track for an early 2027 release?[/h2][p]Maybe! Probably. I don't know. 2026 will be the true determiner of where I land. This year I feel like I'm on track to hit my end-of-2025 goals, which is to have every area nearly fully fleshed out and ready to start implementing quests. There's still a big question mark on if doing that will be possible in 1 year, but we'll see![/p][h2]What are the other magic spells that will be added?[/h2][p]Oh yes... the "magic" part of the title of my game. Well, I've been feeling surprisingly uninspired on that front, mainly because I want the worldbuilding to come first. Since these will just boil down to mechanics that have to be designed to gate progression, I haven't been all that interested since there's no progression in the world to gate yet. But I have had some inklings of ideas, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Swimming in water (partially implemented)[/p][/*][*][p]Dashing (Implemented)[/p][/*][*][p]Teleporting between waypoints[/p][/*][*][p]Negative vision to see invisible characters[/p][/*][*][p]Bring things back to life[/p][/*][*][p]Fill any container with fluid (this was just in my notes, not sure on this one)[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, I might get rid of the lightning attack from the demo... I just don't like the design implications of the way it works currently. I'll have to wrack my brain on how to redo or revamp it - yet another challenge![/p][h2]Any plans to update the Demo before release?[/h2][p]Yes! I want to take some time to get a demo anniversary update out in late august. This would introduce the improved questing systems like a visual that shows which characters want an item, which would reduce the drag of brute-forcing though all the trade quests.[/p][h2]Any other things that could be added?[/h2][p]Oh yes, I've been mulling around on 2 ideas: a currency/shop system and a quest book. For the currency, it would have to be highly controlled (can't just farm gold forever, there's a set amount in the world) to work with the game, and that would take an intense amount of design and testing. And for the quest book, I'm just scared of the work it would add. but it would be so nice! Wouldn't it? Alas.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, you can follow me on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Ffroggy-loops.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] to see more frequent updates. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time stay magical, and thank you for reading![/p]
